channel.title: Tech Kadak — naye free apps
channel.description: Paid app ka FREE jawab — roz naye free apps, AI tools & GitHub gems, simple Hinglish mein.

item.title: Fossify Music Player
item.description: Offline music player: playlists, equalizer, sleep timer, widget. No ads.

item.title: Penpot
item.description: Browser me UI/UX design aur prototyping, team ke saath — open-source Figma jaisa.

item.title: Musicolet
item.description: Offline music player: no ads, internet permission hi nahi, multiple queues, lyrics, tag editor.

item.title: Fossify Calculator
item.description: Saaf-suthra calculator with history, bina ads. Daily hisaab aur basic padhai ke liye.

item.title: Excalidraw
item.description: Hand-drawn style whiteboard browser me: diagrams, flowcharts, notes — dosto ke saath live.

item.title: Fossify Contacts
item.description: Contacts app jo contacts phone pe hi rakhta hai: groups, favourites, vCard import/export, no ads.

item.title: HandBrake
item.description: Video converter: badi video ko chhota (compress) karo ya MP4/MKV me convert — quality bachake.

item.title: Fossify Messages
item.description: Ad-free SMS/MMS app: number aur keyword se spam block, messages export/import, clean design.

item.title: Fossify Phone
item.description: Dialer app: call blocking, speed dial, call history — bina ads aur tracking ke.

item.title: darktable
item.description: RAW photo editor: DSLR/phone RAW photos ka colour grading, exposure, presets.

item.title: Kdenlive
item.description: Free video editor: multitrack timeline, transitions, titles, keyframes, proxy editing — YouTube videos ke liye.

item.title: Fossify Notes
item.description: Simple notes + checklist app, home screen widget ke saath. No ads, no tracking.

item.title: Shotcut
item.description: Simple free video editor: cut, filters, text, colour correction, 4K support, no watermark.

item.title: Fossify Clock
item.description: Alarm, timer, stopwatch aur world clock ek simple app me — bina ads ke.

item.title: OpenShot
item.description: Beginners ke liye easy video editor: drag-drop, titles, transitions, animations — no watermark.

item.title: FlorisBoard
item.description: Privacy wala keyboard: typing data bahar nahi jaata, themes, clipboard history, emoji, one-hand mode.

item.title: Snapseed
item.description: Google ka pro photo editor: healing, selective edit, curves, RAW — bina ads, poora free.

item.title: Audacity
item.description: Audio record aur edit karo: voiceover se noise hatao, cut/trim, effects, podcast editing.

item.title: Unexpected Keyboard
item.description: Chhota keyboard jiski har key ke kono me extra symbols — swipe karke number/symbol. Ctrl, Esc, arrow keys bhi; phone pe coding/Termux ke liye best.

item.title: Simple Keyboard
item.description: Sirf keyboard, aur kuch nahi: bahut halka, internet permission nahi, no ads.

item.title: GIMP
item.description: Photo editing ka free software: layers, masks, retouch, thumbnails, poster — Photoshop wala zyada-tar kaam.

item.title: Olauncher
item.description: Minimal home screen: icons ki jagah sirf apps ke naam, roz naya wallpaper. Phone kam scroll karna hai to kaam ka.

item.title: Krita
item.description: Digital painting aur drawing software: brushes, layers, animation — artists aur illustrators ke liye.

item.title: Indic Keyboard
item.description: Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Malayalam jaisi kai Indian languages ka keyboard — phonetic (English letters se Hindi) aur Inscript dono layouts. No ads.

item.title: Blender
item.description: 3D modelling, animation, VFX aur video editing — sab ek free software me. Bade studios bhi use karte hain.

item.title: Google AI Edge Gallery
item.description: Google ki official app — open-source AI models phone pe offline chalao: AI chat, Ask Image, audio transcribe. Data phone se bahar nahi jaata.

item.title: PocketPal AI
item.description: Phone pe AI chatbot bina internet — Gemma, Qwen, Llama jaise models download karo aur offline chat karo. No account.

item.title: Kiwix
item.description: Poori Wikipedia (aur aur content) offline padho — ek baar download, phir bina internet.

item.title: ChatterUI
item.description: Phone pe AI models chalao ya apne API provider se connect karo — open-source chat frontend.

item.title: KISS Launcher
item.description: Super-fast launcher: home screen pe bas ek search bar — 2-3 letter type karo aur app, contact ya setting turant khul jaata hai. Purane phone pe bhi tez.
